Name: Walk Around Farm
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=4]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

[size=3]I was feeling sad for personal reasons, so to take my mind off things, I created this farm.
This mod adds the custom Walk Around Farm at the game, so called because it has a lot of space. It has ocean and river fish. You can swim in the ocean for recharge energy, and all the grass and dirt is diggable. It has a boat to get to the beach and a minecart to go to the mountains, both one-way. It has ocean and forest fodder, It also adds an additional cave (which does not replace the farm cave) that functions as a greenhouse, where you can put barrels to age, fish, and swim. Since it does not replace the Vanilla farms, feel free to try it out.
It is compatible with all recolors.
This is for PC; unfortunately, I have no way of testing it on mobile device. They wrote to me that it also works on Android.

Installation:
Extract and paste into the Stardew Valley mods folder.
[/size][size=3]Enjoy!
